Business.title: Business
Business.description: Public merchant shop profile, Google Maps/review destination link, and QR scanner state owned by a subscribed merchant.

name.description: Display name of the shop or business shown to customers scanning the QR code.

category.description: Business category such as Cafe & Restaurant, Clinic, Salon, or Retail Store.

slug.description: Unique URL-safe identifier matching the document ID used in /review/{slug}.

locationLabel.description: Optional public neighborhood or city label displayed under the business name.

googleReviewUrl.description: Google Maps or Google Business Profile destination URL.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the merchant owner. Immutable after creation.

isActive.description: Whether the public customer QR scanner page is active.

planId.description: Optional synced SaaS subscription tier for zero-extra-read QR page validation.

subscriptionEndsAtMs.description: Optional synced epoch milliseconds when the merchant's current subscription period expires.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the business profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the business profile was last updated.

ReviewSessionEvent.title: ReviewSessionEvent
ReviewSessionEvent.description: Immutable anonymous telemetry event recorded during a customer QR review-drafting session.

businessSlug.description: Slug of the parent business document.

businessOwnerId.description: Owner UID copied from the parent business document and verified on creation for zero-cost secure owner list queries.

visitId.description: Ephemeral anonymous visit identifier grouping draft, copy, and Google link steps from one QR scan.

usedOptionalPrompts.description: Whether the customer supplied optional experience notes.

stage.description: Step reached in the customer workflow (never claims Google publication).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the anonymous event occurred.

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: Monthly or annual SaaS subscription record governing a merchant's shop QR scanner allowance and active period.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the subscribed merchant.

accountLabel.description: Non-PII merchant or company display label.

status.description: Subscription lifecycle state; canceled is terminal unless restored by platform admin.

maxBusinesses.description: Maximum shop QR scanners allowed by the selected tier (1, 5, or 25).

priceInr.description: Plan price in INR for the selected billing cycle.

paymentReference.description: UPI UTR, payment gateway reference ID, or FREE_TRIAL marker.

currentPeriodEndMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the current billing period or trial ends.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription was last updated.

PlatformBillingConfig.title: PlatformBillingConfig
PlatformBillingConfig.description: Founder-managed SaaS payment collection settings (UPI QR VPA, payment links, support contact, trial duration).

upiId.description: Founder UPI ID (VPA) used to render scannable merchant subscription checkout QR codes.

payeeName.description: Merchant payee display name for subscription checkout.

paymentLinkStarter.description: Optional Razorpay/Stripe checkout link for the Starter plan.

paymentLinkGrowth.description: Optional Razorpay/Stripe checkout link for the Growth plan.

paymentLinkAgency.description: Optional Razorpay/Stripe checkout link for the Agency plan.

supportContact.description: Optional founder support label or WhatsApp contact string.

trialDays.description: Number of free trial days granted to new shops (0 to 30).

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who updated billing settings.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last billing config update.

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Trusted database role record granting platform administrator privileges.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

grantedByUid.description: UID of the administrator who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin role was created.

/businesses/{businessSlug}.description: Top-level collection of merchant shop profiles and QR scanner configurations keyed by unique URL slug.

/businesses/{businessSlug}/sessions/{ses.description: Append-only subcollection of anonymous customer review-drafting events belonging to a business.

/subscriptions/{userId}.description: Merchant monthly/annual SaaS subscription records keyed by the merchant's Firebase Auth UID.

/platformSettings/{configId}.description: Singleton platform payment configuration document (/platformSettings/billing) managed exclusively by platform admins.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted collection of delegated platform administrator UIDs.
